QUOTE: Only `ServerManager::execute` calls `is_denied` (`server_manager.cpp:159`). Deny therefore beats allow... The deny list is checked later, inside `ServerManager::execute`, and it overrides everything that came before it.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is checked in ServerManager::execute, but it also describes the allow list and other gates (tier, MCP key, check_approval) that can block execution, so it doesn't conclude deny is the only blocking list or that execute consults only is_denied.
